'''Moralan''' was a [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Moralan (species)|Moralans]], a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Hutt Empire]]. During the [[Xim Wars|conflict]] between the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] conqueror [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] twenty-five [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the forces of the latter entered the [[Moralan system/Legends|Moralan system]].

When the Tionese later withdrew from the [[Star system/Legends|system]], they encouraged the Moralan to launch a successful rebellion against the Hutts, and a [[Moralan republic|republic]] governed by the [[Parliament of Moralan]] was established. In response, however, Hutt forces led by [[Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu/Legends|Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu]] [[Invasion of Moralan|defeated]] the Moralan, after which the planet was sterilized.

==Description==
Moralan was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Moralan system/Legends|Moralan system]], a part of the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. During the [[Xim Wars]] of [[25,102 BBY]]&ndash;[[25,096 BBY]], Moralan was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]] as well as to the interior of Hutt Space. Those [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes eventually ceased to exist, and Moralan instead became connected by a hyperlane to Hutt Space's [[Usk system/Legends|Usk system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Moralan was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Moralan (species)|same name]]. The Moralan were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species, with the Moralan homeworld constituting a part of the [[Hutt Empire]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Xim Wars.<ref name="TEA" /> During that conflict between the Hutts and the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] conqueror [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]], the latter's forces entered the Moralan [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>

[[File:MoralanXimWars-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Hutt Empire planet Moralan became involved in the empire's war against the Tionese conqueror Xim.]]
In [[25,100 BBY]] and [[25,099 BBY]], Xim suffered [[First Battle of Vontor|two]] [[Second Battle of Vontor|defeats]] against Hutt forces at [[Vontor]].<ref name="Xim" /> Hoping to inspire revolts among the Hutt slave species<ref name="EGTW" />&mdash;and offering a concession to buy time for preparing war materiel for another confrontation&mdash;the [[Human/Legends|Human]] ruler withdrew his forces from the Moralan system. Encouraged by the Tionese, the Moralan then launched a successful rebellion against the Hutts<ref name="Xim" /> and established a [[Moralan republic|republic]]<ref name="TEA" /> governed by the [[Parliament of Moralan]].<ref name="EGTW" />

In response, [[Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu/Legends|Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu]] led Hutt forces<ref name="TEA" /> in a three-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] [[Invasion of Moralan|battle]] against the Parliament of Moralan. Eventually,<ref name="Polyhedron170">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref> the Hutts swiftly overran Moralan,<ref name="Xim" /> and Boonta ordered the planet to be sterilized as an object lesson for the rest of the Hutt slave species.<ref name="EGTW" />

As a result, the Moralan were rendered extinct, with their home planet left a ruined world.<ref name="TEA" /> Subsequently, [[Clan-General]] [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv]] of the Hutt Empire offered to cede the world of [[Boonta/Legends|Ko Vari]] as well as the ravaged remains of Moralan to Xim if he won a [[Third Battle of Vontor|third battle]] at Vontor, which saw the Human's final defeat and capture by the Hutts.<ref name="Xim" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I gathered the roster of worlds that hadn't been placed but that sources indicated were in Hutt Space&mdash;the likes of Saki, Ganath, Kleeva, Moralan, Circumtore, and Nimban&mdash;and added them to the map in pencil.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Suvudu">{{Suvudu|url=2009/08/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-mapping-hutt-space.html|text=STAR WARS: THE ESSENTIAL ATLAS &ndash; Mapping Hutt Space}}</ref>}}
[[File:Essential_Atlas.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Moralan was first identified as a planet in ''The Essential Atlas''.]]
The planet Moralan was first explicitly mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square T-10.<ref name="TEA" /> That mention drew upon a reference to the Parliament of Moralan in "[[Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]," a [[roleplaying game]] source article authored by [[Rich Handley]] and [[Abel G. Peña]] for use with the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in the [[Polyhedron 170|170th issue]] of the ''[[Polyhedron]]'' magazine in [[June]] [[2004]].<ref name="Polyhedron170" />

In a 2009 [[Unbound Worlds|Suvudu]] article describing the creation of the map of Hutt Space for ''The Essential Atlas'', Fry related that in [[2006]], after sketching an outline for the borders of that region with a ballpoint pen and noting the few systems that previously published sources had placed on maps, he composed a list of worlds that were implied to be in Hutt Space but had not been explicitly depicted as part of the region. During that process, Fry envisioned "Moralan" as a planet's name and subsequently added it to the map-in-progress in pencil.<ref name="Suvudu" />
